acceptanceCriteria: A moved ref refreshes the tree and index before the next answer.
A dirty tree is never modified, and responses flag the stale binding.
A missing ref is a typed error.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1046 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem An MCP server rooted at a worktree answers for whatever revision that worktree holds. Keeping agents on the integration branch head needs an external sync and reindex. Current workaround A script detaches the worktree at the branch head when it is clean and runs `index --if-stale`, leaving a dirty worktree alone and logging it. Proposal `corvint-mcp --follow-ref REF` on a dedicated detached worktree: refresh and reindex on a clean tree when the ref moves, report DIRTY instead of changing a dirty tree, and echo the resolved commit in every response. See beamfall/corvint#1046 for the full text.
title: corvint-mcp: follow a branch head on a dedicated worktree (issue #1046)
